title: Definition Pin Reference Kind
description: Kinds of third-party-published definition that a definition pin can cover. Each kind names the adagents.json array the pinned entry is read from. Property lists, collection lists, product-local format options, seller-inline placements, product and signal-source signals, and default-mode selections are not pinnable.

enumDescriptions.publisher_format_option: A publisher-catalog format option (format-option-ref scope 'publisher'), read from the top-level formats[] of the publisher's adagents.json.
enumDescriptions.publisher_placement: A publisher-catalog placement (publisher_ref placement identity), read from placements[] of the publisher's adagents.json.
enumDescriptions.publisher_collection: A collection declared in the publisher's adagents.json collections[].
enumDescriptions.data_provider_signal: A signal published by a data provider in signals[] of its adagents.json (signal_ref scope 'data_provider').
